newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria controllers' dispute delays air traffic.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria controllers' dispute delays air traffic.

text.p: The number of international flights crossing over Bulgaria has been halved to 700 a day by an air-controllers'pay strike, officials said on Sunday.
The stoppage has also led to delays of up to 90 minutes for overflying traffic.
On Friday some 40 controllers were fired for refusing to go back to work after a court ruled the strike illegal.
Transport Minister Stamen Stamenov said at the weekend he would begin negotiations to get the controllers back to work.
